name: hasActiveIncidentTicketing
definition: True when the vendor's own incident records show incidents are routed to a connected ticketing (PSA) system.
population: the incident reports the connected managed-detection tenant lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one incident report that carries a ticket id from the connected ticketing system (proof even on a partial read), or a complete read of at least one report none of which carries one (False). No incident report, an error or refused answer, or a partial read with no ticket id is not measured.
citations: safeguards/mdr/huntress/hasActiveIncidentTicketing.py (Huntress REST API v1, GET /v1/incident_reports, IncidentReport.psa_ticket_eids: https://api.huntress.io/docs)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Huntress transform can emit it.

notes: Registered so the transform named in citations can emit it. Other vendors that use the same name were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.
